Bɩ minto y'a ka, wɔɔ n nɩ Ziidi kan Silas kɩ nyɔɔrɛ awɔɔ ma, kʊ ŋ nɩ bɩ minno nɔɔn duro hɩ awɔɔ m a lɛ m.
Sʊrdaa tisi lɛɛzaa bɩ n a gaa a wɔ ma, an bɔ m toore ma, an a lar, a ʊ: «Bɔ ɩbɩɩ ʊ k'ɩ hɩ mɔɔ nɩ?» Nyukumbueere bɩ n a hɩ m, a ʊ:
Gʊaa k'a sɩra ba kan hɔ poore kɩ, a sɩra barɛ a gʊta m sɔ. Bɩ gʊaa k'a n sɩra ba hɔ poore m, a bɩ sɩra bam hɔ gʊta m sɔ y.
Gʊɔɔ k'awɔɔ n'a hɔɔn darɛ ŋ ma a ʊ, zibəəzannɔ kʊ ŋ lɛ da rɔ nɩ ŋ mɩ rɔ wɔɔ, mɔɔ y'a gɩngam m ʊ ŋ n lɛ da mɔɔ nɩ y.
Bala, k'a mɩŋŋa n tɩrga, an nɩ ŋ kʊ b'ʊ bɩ, a yɩ ŋ zibəə bʊnyaarɔ wɔɔ yɩm, an nɩ ŋ mim mam, naa n a ka k'an tɩrga bɩ, a heer nɩ kɔm, gʊɔɔ wɔɔ zibəə bʊnyaarɔ wɔɔ tɔ ma.
Bɩ, dɔmɩm kʊ Lɔttɩ bɔ ʊ Sodɔm ʊ bɩ, Woso a ka sɛ n a to brama, an ba am la hɔ bɩ m, an ŋ zɩnzɛ haay.
Yeezuu n a hɩ m, a ʊ: «Sɩra ka mɔɔ ʊ, lʊ, wakatɩ ɩ zɛm, awɔɔ b'a yarɛ a Zɩ Woso da ʊ ci naa do mim ʊ, bɩ Zerizalɛm nɩ y.
Her-her naa, bɔ a ʊ kʊ ʊ, ɩ ʊ, dɩga wɔɔ nawʊm jɛtɩga ʊ,
Pɩlatɩ k'a naa ma bɩ, a a ka, ŋnɩ bɔ Yeezuu m. Pɩlatɩ n nyɩnta dʊdɔkarɛ gɔ bɩ ra, bɩncɛ kʊ n'a birm *ebree lemim m Gabata b'ʊ.
A a hɩnka Sefas m, bɩ jɛ ʊ an a hɩnka bueerehɩɩyɔɔ k'a ŋ bɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ m.
A n a hɩ ŋ nɩ, a ʊ: «Hɔbɩrɛ niŋŋə n ta ʊ mɔɔ nɩ m ga m, m a bɩ, b'awɔɔ n a dɔ y.»
A yom zi bʊnyaa do haay ma, an gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ nyaanɩm nɔ wɔɔ nyʊnnyɔɔ, brɔɔ nyaanɩm, bala, sɩra k'a n'a dam ma an ŋ bʊmbɔ bɩ, ŋ n a ŋʊa, bɩ, ŋ n yɛ ma y.
Dɔmɩm bɩ do ʊ bɩ, Maarii wuti zɔɔ-zɔɔ, an zaa sa, an bɔ kʊrɔ kʊ ciro n ta ʊ rɔ wɔɔ ʊ, an ta Zidee kʊ deem nɔ ʊ.
K'a meer naa do ba an a nya bɩ, nyaa wuti farizɛɛnrɔ wɔɔ bire ʊ kan sadisɛɛnrɔ wɔɔ kɩ. Zamaa bɩ n a gʊngʊ.
Sɩrakarɛ tɔ ma m, Rahab n ga kan bɩsɩkawosomazannɔ wɔɔ kɩ y, a yɛ an dundolɛɛzizannɔ wɔɔ si a har ʊ an a mɩŋŋa ba ŋ nɩ.
Bala, biisi bɩ, awɔɔ nyaam am seero hɔ bɩ m, bɩ kɛɛrɛ naa, awɔɔ a bɔ a bʊr a dundor bɩ zi, an nɩ dɔrɛ awɔɔ ma sɔ.

Gʊaa haay a dɔ, a ʊ, Ziida do gʊaa m, Moyiisi n do naa do mim hɩ mannɩbənno wɔɔ mim bɩncɛ ʊ y.

Ŋ y'a dɔ kɛɛrɛ, ŋ ʊ, hɔ haay k'ɩbɩɩ ka mɔɔ ʊ bɩ, a to a ʊ ɩbɩɩ zi.

Awɔɔ n a dɔ a ʊ, awɔɔ mɛrɔ wɔɔ Krista mɛ vəŋŋəro m na? Mɔɔ yɛrɛ m Krista mɛ vəŋŋə sa m a ba lʊmɩŋŋahɛɛrɛzaa mɛ vəŋŋə ra? Ayy…, fɩɩga!
Bala, kʊ mɔɔ m, lemim nyɩnta bɩ pa darɛ bɩ, lɛbɔ a mɩŋŋa ʊ hɔ bɛɛ y. Pakra m kʊ mɔɔ n a pa da, bɩ, kʊ mɔɔ n a pa da, kʊ kʊsɩ n m yɩ.
Kʊ mɔɔ nɩ, mɔɔ nyɩnta m a si mɩŋŋa mɔɔ ʊ lɛ m, kʊ m yar ba kan Nazarɛtɩ Yeezuu bɩ tɔ bɩ kɩ, paŋŋa do haay m.
Gʊaa k'an Woso gʊaa bɩ, Woso lemim an n'a tʊr kam ma. Kʊ Woso gʊɔɔ bɛɛ n'awɔɔ m bɩ y'a ka, awɔɔ bɩr a tʊr kam mɔɔ ma y.»
Bɩ tɔ ma m, awɔɔ n'a heer nyɔɔm gʊta, baa kʊ pakra m k'awɔɔ n fɩr yɩ dɩɩtaa, makrarɔ y'a hʊnhɔ kʊ ŋ n'awɔɔ heer zarm dɔmɩm poorero nɔɔn duro nɔ ʊ.
Bɩ y'a ka mɔɔ n a yɛ kʊ m awɔɔ yɩ, kʊ m sʊʊra ba kan awɔɔ kɩ. Kʊ sɩra nɩ, Israyɛl taaheerlɛ minto y'a ka, mɔɔ nɩ baŋŋarɔ nɔɔn duro m.»
A n a hɩ, a ʊ: «Ma naa do n'a kam Woso nɩ gʊaasɩbabaa darɛ awɔɔ ma. Woso lɛ taa k'awɔɔ n ta a lɛ ra gʊaasɩbabaa bɩ nɔ ʊ.»
Awɔɔ lɛ taa k'a a dɔ a ʊ, Krista a meerbaa da mɔɔ lɛ ʊ mɔɔ n'a bam, gɛɛ lɔ? K'a maam awɔɔ y'a dɔrɛ. Paŋŋawarzaa bɛɛ m Krista m awɔɔ gʊr zi y. A y'a paŋŋa bɩ hɩnkarɛ awɔɔ bire ʊ.
K'a heer zaar ba a kʊrɔmarɔ wɔɔ tɔ ma! K'a zɛ heerzar ba a nyi ka! K'a yaawʊrɛ to a nyi ka, k'a a heernyɔɔ bɩ to, a a heer zar!
Mɔɔ zoo mɩŋŋa ba, mɔɔ brasire a tɛkka ku, mɔɔ nyasʊ sɩrakarɛ m.
Yeezuu n a nyɩ bɔ ʊ, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ pa da gʊaa haay m, mɔɔ hɔ dɩnda gʊɔɔ m dɔmɩm haay *sokʊmacɛrɔ ʊ kan *Wosocɛ ʊ kɩ, bɩncɛ kʊ zɩɩfʊrɔ haay n'a som kʊ ma ʊ, bɩ mɔɔ n hɔsɩ nyaakʊm da, m a hɩ y.
Bɩ Woso barka ka wɔɔ gʊaa biyəə ʊ, Krista n a jir a hɔɔnhɔ ma.
K'a jɩm kɔɔkɔɔ a yaa ka a nɔ ʊ, a a mɩsɩrbaa bɩ dɔ ra am cɛ hɔ bɩ m. A nyasʊ a sɩrakarɛ bɩ m kɔɔkɔɔ, amba n y'a dɩnda awɔɔ n bɩ m, a bɩr yaa dam Woso m barka kan a heer kɩ haay.
Kʊ ŋ kɔɔlʊʊ poore bɩ gaa ŋn'a da kɔɔlʊʊ b'ʊ an nya bɩ, ŋ bar sunso kɔɔlʊʊ gʊta b'ʊ kɛɛrɛ.
Bɩ y'a ka, hɔ kʊ bɔɔr naa do a hɩ bɩ sɩra m, a ʊ: gʊaa deem ɩ hɔ duure, gʊaa vanta n nɩ zɛm b'a da.
Bɩ, kʊ m zaa k'an mɩŋŋa an cem haay bɩ hɩnka a m kɛɛrɛ.
Ŋ n a hɩ Galilee kʊ Bɛtsayɩdaa gʊaa Filipi m, ŋ ʊ: «Wɔɔ harzaa, wɔɔ lɛ n taa k'ʊ Yeezuu yɩ.»
Bɩ jɛ ʊ, lɛsarɛ dɔmɩm ʊ, Galilee gʊaa Zidas a hɩnka wɔɔ m. Gʊɔɔ gʊta nɩ zure a jɛ ʊ. Bɩ mɩŋŋa ga sɔ, gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ zure a jɛ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ n hɩsɩga da.
Sɩra nɔ ʊ, lɛɛ kʊ jɩmbaa n ta ʊ, gʊɔɔ n'a hɔɔn darɛ a mɩŋŋɔɔ ma con bɩ, lɛɛ bɩ do ʊ bɩ, hɔ haay woo… yɩm bʊrga, ziro bʊnyaarɔ n nyɩnta ʊ sɔ.

A n bɔkarɛ gʊɔɔ wɩsɩrɔ m Woso mɩm ʊ, durnya naa do gʊɔɔ wɔɔ n a ga m kʊ gʊɔɔ nɔɔn duro n nyɩnta kan ŋ kɩ y. Ŋ sɩrakarɛ tɔ ma m, ŋ ba lɛɛ nɩ y, ŋn'ɩ poo sam kan ciro gaa kɩ, ŋn'ɩ wʊtam yaarɔ ʊ kan ciro yaarɔ kɩ ʊ.
A n lɛ ka sʊrdaa zɔrɔ lɛɛzaa b'ʊ, a ʊ, an dɔ Pol ma, b'a b'a du y. A b'a ta a gʊaasɩba sɩ m tolle, a nyasʊm minto y.
Ɩ tɔ ʊ ɩ bʊr, kʊ nyɛɛm dɔmɩm n bɔkarɛ an a ku. Ebulus kan Pudɛns kɩ, Linus kɩ, Klodɩya kan danyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ naa ʊ haay rɔ wɔɔ k'ɩ yaa darɛ ɩ m.
A ŋʊa mɔɔ nawʊm paan… kʊ m bɩr awɔɔ bire ʊ b'ʊ dɩɩtaa, kʊ m m meerbaa bɩ lʊr m a ba, bala, mɔɔ n a dɔ kʊ mɔɔ meer bɩ bam kan awɔɔ kɩ lʊnlɔ y.
A n lɛ da haay bɩ, k'a bɩr kʊ ŋʊam paan…, bala, ŋʊarɛ ɩ hɔ kam mimbʊnyaa yɔɔgʊ ra.
Gʊaa k'a nɩ koor bam biisi bɩ, an a wɔ bɔ koorbaa b'ʊ k'an zi ba an a lɛɛmaa hɔ yɩ, maam bɩ, a y'a dam ma an hɔ yɩ, an n'a dam gʊaa k'a lɛ n taa daahan ma han.
Bala, n y'a da lɛrɔ wɔɔ duro ʊ, n ʊ: «Ɩ bɩ hɔ du der k'a nɩ hɔyaa zɔm bɩ lɛ ma y.» A hɩ awɔɔ ʊ, Woso bɩ kɔ a nawʊm dono ma,
K'a yɛ fɩr k'awɔɔ n'a yɩm bɩ ma, ɩ ʊ, hʊnhʊrlɛ m. Bala, awɔɔ fɩr bɩ yɩrɛ y'a hɩnkarɛ a ʊ, Woso ɩ dɩgarɛ awɔɔ ma a nyɩnɔ. Nyɩ ka n ta ʊ, a zɩ bɩr a hʊnhʊrlɛ?
Bɩ kʊ wɔɔ ʊ: «Mimbʊnyaa ba wɔɔ ma y», bra wɔɔ n'a barɛ ʊ mɩŋŋɔɔ m, sɩra bɩ wɔɔ nɔ ʊ y.
Karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ n lɛɛ ka ŋnɩ hɔ k'a nɩ zɛm naa jɩ dɔ hɔɔ y. Bɩ, kʊ ŋ Yeezuu lɛbɔʊrɛ yɩ bɩ, ŋ hɔ kʊ ŋ y'a gʊrsɩra ba a minto bɩ tɔ da a nɔ ʊ, bɩ naa ba ŋ y'a ʊ a minto.
Wɔɔ kan kʊ bɩ danyɩnɔ wɔɔ kɩ, wɔɔ yɛ Pol han k'a bɩ ta Zerizalɛm ʊ b'ʊ y.
Wosocikarɩnsaambɔɔ gɔsɩnnɔ meerbaa bɩ si, ŋ ʊ: «Karɩnsaamba, ɩ meer ba mɩŋŋa.»
K'a dundo a zi, a jɩm kɔɔkɔɔ sɩrakarɛ nɔ ʊ, a bɩr heer koodə m, a bɩr paŋŋa m.
Naa minto m, wɔɔ nɩ yɛm kɔrɛ ma, ʊ n'ʊ yoŋ ʊ, bala, Woso k'a m mɩsɩr bɩ wɔɔ ta ʊ heer lɛ. A m gʊaa haay bʊmbɔrɛzaa, bɩ gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ sɩra ka rɔ wɔɔ an nɩ ŋ bʊmbɔm.
Dɔmɩm biyəə, amba Wosocɛ ʊ gɛɛ har ʊ, ŋ bɩr Yeezuu Krista lemim nyɩnta bɩ dɩndarɛ kan a padarɛ kɩ tore y.
Naa tɔ ma bɩ, kʊ wɔɔ ɩ hɔbɩrɛ m kan huu kɩ m, naa a ga m, an wɔɔ bɔ.
Pɩyɛɛr n zer, an gʊɔɔ wɔɔ zɛ ʊ, an a hɩ, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ ba n nɩ. Mɔɔ awɔɔ n'a karɛ m ma bɩ. Bɔ minto y'a ka awɔɔ n bʊr naa ʊ?»
Sɩrakarɛ y'a ka Moyiisi k'a b'a ba gʊaa burgu bɩ, a n yɛ kʊ ŋ n'a bir Farawɔn nyɩmbʊɛɛrɛ nyɩ y.
Lerbɔrɛ niŋŋə kʊ Zɩ a bɔ wɔɔ m bɩ m mɩsɩrbaa k'a nyarɛ ba ʊ bɩ m.
K'a lɛɛ ka a ŋ ka lɛɛ, a dɩga ŋ ma, kʊ mim ba ŋ gʊr zi, k'a bɔkarɛ a ŋ da daahanbaa zibəə b'ʊ.
K'a a banka a jɩm kɔɔkɔɔ. K'a sɩra so a mɔr ʊ, am hɔsoaʊ hɔ bɩ m, k'a bɩr tɩrgabaa m, goŋŋo kʊ n n'a dure a ma n bɩ, k'a du a ma.
Ŋ y'a barɛ awɔɔ m ncɩnaaʊ, bala, ŋ n Zɩ dɔ, ŋ n mɔɔ dɔ sɔ y.
Bɩ, ŋ b'a dam ma ŋnɩ ta lɛɛ y, bala, gʊaa woo… sʊrlɛ ŋ hɔɔnwar zibəə bɩ ra, amba n nyɩnta n nɩ sʊr Zanɛs kan Zambrɛs kɩ hɔ ra bɩ m.

Wɔɔ ma ŋ ʊ, wɔɔ gʊɔɔ gɔsɩnnɔ ɩ b'awɔɔ wʊnwar kʊ ma, ŋn'awɔɔ heer zar, ŋnɩ dabɔʊ da awɔɔ ma kan a meerbaarɔ kɩ, bɩ wɔɔ n ŋ nyɔɔ y.
A bɔ k'awɔɔ nawʊm Woso k'a awɔɔ bir k'awɔɔ n yɩ a gʊɔɔ Krista barka minto b'ʊ, a ta k'a zu lemim nyɩnta vanta ʊ bɩ, a a ka mɔɔ n zɛ kədə.
Kʊ bur bɩ n deem bɩ, wɔɔ haay, mɛ deem zannɔ wɔɔ m sɔ, bala, bur deem bɩ wɔɔ ʊ da kʊ ʊ haay ʊ n'a bɩm.
Fɩryɩrɛ n ta ʊ an nɩ mɔɔ yɩm. A gore ta ʊ kan mɔɔ kɩ, b'a mɔɔ ku an nya.
Hɔ kʊ wɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ ɩbɩɩ m bɩ ba. Wɔɔ ɩ gʊɔɔyaarɔ m si, ŋnɩ ler bɔ Woso m.
Mɔɔ vəŋŋə haay k'a bɩr nyɩ dam bɩ, n y'a zɛm la, n n a zo. Bɩ, mɔɔ vəŋŋə haay k'a nyɩ da bɩ, n y'a bankarɛ, k'an nyɩ da an lɛ da biisi ra.
Bɩ hɔ k'ɩbɩɩ n'a duum bɩ, kʊ yɩryaa m gɛɛ hɔ vanta m, hɔ bɩ yaa ɩbɩɩ n'a duum, a gɔ bɛɛ ɩbɩɩ n'a sɔɔn wa.
K'awɔɔ ɩ naa bam, a bʊnyaa awɔɔ n'a barɛ a danyɩnɔ paŋŋawarzannɔ wɔɔ m, an nɩ ŋ heer warm kʊ ma, bɩ mimbʊnyaa naa do ba awɔɔ nawʊm Krista m sɔ.

Woso n durnya k'a nyɩnta ʊ biisi bɩ to y, a a ka hi gʊta n bʊr an bɩ gʊɔɔ wɔɔ zaar ba, nyɩnta brɔɔ ʊ gʊɔɔ bʊnyaarɔ. Bɩ, Woso Nowee bʊmbɔ, kan gʊɔɔ vantɔɔ kɩ saanhɩna. Bɩ nyɩnta an nɩ zi mɩŋŋa barɛ pa dam.
A maasɩrɛ ba, an a zɔ wakatɩ kaakʊ ma, a lʊ bɩ n bɩ gasʊ, an a dɔ kʊ bɔ ɩ ba y.
Ŋ n ŋ gaa, ŋnɩ bɩ ŋ hɩnka dʊdɔkənno wɔɔ m. Wosocɛmannɩbər jɩtaarɛ bɩ n ŋ lar, a ʊ:
Fɛstus n maasɩrɛ ba ŋ bire ʊ y, a n lɛ da dɔmɩm sinnyə m gɛɛ bu nɩ y. K'a lee ku Sezaree ʊ bɩ, a dɔ k'a mɛ bɩ, a yaa nyɩnta a dʊdɔkarɛ bɩncɛ ʊ, an a ka n n bʊr Pol m.
M danyɩnɔ, gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ Woso zi bam awɔɔ barla ŋnɩ karɛ awɔɔ lɛɛ, ŋn'awɔɔ bɔm zaa ʊ Zuuba zaa nɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ, a yɛ wɔɔ nawʊrɛ awɔɔ han k'a ŋ gore da ʊ.
A bɩ ŋʊaar ba kʊ nɩ y, bala, awɔɔ a bɔ a mɩsɩrbaa gusire b'ʊ, kan a zibəəro bʊnyaarɔ wɔɔ kɩ ʊ.
Wosolɛsinnɩsorazannɔ wɔɔ haay, an a sa Sanwɛl ma kan a jɛzannɔ kɩ dɔmɩnnɔ kʊ wɔɔ n ta ʊ rɔ wɔɔ nɔɔn mim hɩ.
Kayiifʊ deem-deem bɩ do ɩ zɩɩfʊrɔ wɔɔ dʊndɔ, a ʊ: kʊ gʊaa deem ga gʊaa haay minto, a jɩra bɩ.
K'awɔɔ b'a dam a poore bɩ barɛ ma bɩ, bɔ minto m, awɔɔ n n'a heer kɔm kan bɔ ɩ gɔɔta haay bɩ kɩ?
Bɩ y'a ka, k'ɩbɩɩ mɔɔ bir bɩ, mɔɔ n bɩsɩ ka zɛrɛ ma y. Bɩ naa ma bɩ, mɔɔ lɛ n taa kʊ m m birle bɩ jɩ dɔ.»
Kʊ bɔ zi awɔɔ n'a bam, k'a ba kan a heer kɩ haay, ɩ ʊ, Zuuba zi awɔɔ n'a bam, gʊɔɔ hɔ bɛɛ y.
A n aa gʊaa yɩ b'ʊ a tɔ m Enee. Yɩnyar a ʊ an nɩ wʊtam kan mɛgarɛ kɩ a gargʊ burə ʊ dɔɔraa sinnyə.
Kʊ Yeezuu b'a dɔ a ʊ, farizɛɛnrɔ wɔɔ a ma, ŋn'a dɩndarɛ ŋ ʊ, a ɩ *karɩndanyɩnɔ yɩm gʊta, an nɩ *batɛm karɛ an lɛ da Zaan ra bɩ,
N y'a nyasʊm, n n'a ka kɩfɩɩrɔ ʊ kʊ ŋ nɩ yaa wʊ ma, kʊ ŋ n'a sʊnsɔ wʊ, kʊ ŋ nɩ lihi dɩnda ma,
Sɩra nɔ ʊ, wɔɔ ʊ ga m, ʊ daahan yɩ awɔɔ zi, bɩ, wɔɔ y'a ŋʊa ʊ zim k'ʊ lɛɛmaa hɔ bɩ, k'awɔɔ n zu wɔɔ hɔbaa ʊ.
Minno nɔɔn duro wɔɔ yaabɔɔ wɔɔ yɩ, k'an nyɩnta makra, bɩ y'a ka n ŋ da ci ʊ, kʊ wɔɔ m hɔɔn yɩ ʊ ŋ tɔ ma, wɔɔ kʊ wɔɔ n'ʊ mɩsɩrbaa bam jɛ dɔmɩnnɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ.
Kʊ karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ nɩ, Sɛnt-Ɛspri kan heernyɔɔ kɩ ŋ heer han.
Gʊaa k'a yɩ b'a kasɛtɩ ka, b'a kasɛtɩ bɩ sɩra m. B'a dɔ, a ʊ, sɩra an n'a hɩm, k'awɔɔ n a si sɩra sɔ.
Denter sɔ, k'awɔɔ a gʊngʊ a hʊnhɔ, bɩ n n'a kam n nɩ gʊɔɔ kʊ taalɛrazannɔ m nɔ wɔɔ dɔ.
K'awɔɔ nɩ wosogʊɔɔ wɔɔ barla bɩ, Woso y'awɔɔ ŋʊa, an awɔɔ bɔ ʊ k'a a so awɔɔ ʊ. Bɩ tɔ ma bɩ, k'a bɩr kʊ ŋʊarɛ m, a bɩr mɩŋŋabaa bam kʊ m, a bɩr mɩŋŋazerle m, kan bʊgʊ-bʊgʊdabaa kɩ m, bʊraama kɩ m.
Mɔɔ heer yɩ nyɩnta gʊta, bala, danyɩnɔ bʊr naa ʊ, ŋn'ɩbɩɩ mɩsɩrbaa kasɛtɩ karɛ, ŋ ʊ, ɩbɩɩ ɩ tam sɩra nɔ ʊ. Bɩ denter m, ɩbɩɩ ɩ tam sɩra nɔ ʊ.
«Nyɩnta mɔɔ ʊ Zoppee kʊ nɔ ʊ, m nɩ yaa dam, mɔɔ m hɔhɩnkarɛ yɩ. Hɔ niŋŋə y'a to brama, an nɩ zerm, an bɔ kʊ ʊ kan pɛɛra gʊta kɩ, n n a bɔ kʊ ʊ, an bɩ lee ku mɔɔ zi.
M gʊaasɩbɔɔ, kʊ wɔɔ heer bɩr mim kam wɔɔ ra, wɔɔ heer koodə Woso zi.
Bala, kʊ wɔɔ mɛ bɩ do sa, wɔɔ bɩ nyɩntam dɩgɩ fɩɩga y.
A dɔ Abraham ʊ a heer ʊ a ʊ, Woso ɩ paŋŋa m k'a Izakkɩ mɩm bɔ ʊ, denter sɔ, Woso a ya an Izakkɩ ka Abraham ʊ ɩ ʊ, a mɩm a a bɔ ʊ.
amba mɔɔ Zɩ mɔɔ dɔ, mɔɔ nɩ m Zɩ dɔ bɩ m. Bɩ, m mɩsɩrbaa mɔɔ n'a karɛ m seero wɔɔ minto.
A n a ya an yaa da, kʊ la bɩ n ba, Woso n a ka la bɩ n ba, hɔbɩrɛ n nyɩnta ʊ tara burə ʊ.
Yeezuu a ya, an a hɩ, a ʊ: «Gʊaa bɩ kara hannyɩ n ta ʊ, an ta an aa hɩ m dibsir ma, a ʊ: ‹M hannyɩ, bur zɩm sa m m kaakʊ,
Kʊ Martɩ a ma, n ʊ, Yeezuu ɩ zɛm bɩ, a ta, an aa a zɛ ʊ, Maarii n gɔɔta har ʊ, an nɩ nyɩntam.
Bɩ ŋ y'a ba, ŋnɩ Barnabas kan Sol kɩ bɔ ʊ, ŋnɩ ŋ nyɔɔ gʊɔɔgusinno wɔɔ ma kan daahan bɩ kɩ.

Gʊaa k'a nɩ lemim y'a hʊnhɔ hɩm bɩ, a mɩŋŋa paŋŋa an n'a dam la, bɩ gʊaa k'a nɩ Woso lɛ sire an nɩ som la bɩ, sokʊmagʊɔɔ wɔɔ an nɩ ŋ paŋŋa dam la.

Kʊ nyɩnta awɔɔ ʊ a mɔɔ dɔ, awɔɔ mɔɔ Zɩ bɩ dɔm sɔ. Bɩ dɩɩtaa naa, awɔɔ dɔ, a yɩ sɔ.»
Karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ n a cɩnta kan kʊ kɩ, gʊaa biyəə kan a wɔhɔ kɩ, k'a nyɔɔ a danyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ Zidee ʊ rɔ wɔɔ daahan minto.

Gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ b'ʊ rɔ wɔɔ n həən si ma, ŋ ʊ: «Wosocɛmannɩbər jɩtaarɛ b'ɩbɩɩ n'a sʊnsɔ wʊm naa ra?» Pol n a nyɩ bɔ ʊ, a ʊ:
K'awɔɔ ba ncɩnaaʊ, kʊ dundonno jɩtaarɛ bɩ bɩ bʊr, a y'a kam awɔɔ n nyɩnta a lɛbɔʊrɛ k'a bɩr a zarm bɩ nɔ ʊ.
Bɩ, wosocikarɩnsaamba bɩ k'a lɛ n taa k'a gumə ka a mɩŋŋa ʊ bɩ, a Yeezuu lar, a ʊ: «Nka m mɔɔ mim nɩ?»

Wɔɔ mɛ vəŋŋəro kʊ ŋ nɩ ta daʊrɛ m nɔ wɔɔ bɩr a kam nyasʊrɛ bɩ do ma y. Woso k'a gʊaa vəŋŋəro da bɩ, a zi bɩ ba a ʊ, kʊ vəŋŋəro kʊ ŋ ba daʊrɛ m nɔ wɔɔ n daʊrɛ yɩ gʊta.

Ʊ ʊ ya, ʊ makra sa, kʊ hɔsɩra ɩ la hi yɩm tee… an n'a mim, k'a ɩ hɔ bam mɩŋŋa a wʊrɛzannɔ wɔɔ n'a bɩrɛ, naa y'a hɩnkarɛ a ʊ, Woso tara bɩ do barka da ʊ.

A nyɩntam gʊaa gʊta, bɩ n y'a birm Woso k'a lɛ da haay Nyɩ. Zuuba Woso y'a yaaba Davɩd cirbəə bɩncɛ kaŋ ʊ,

Kʊ wɔɔ nɩ, wɔɔ b'ʊ dam ma, ʊ hɔ kʊ wɔɔ yɩ, ʊ a ma bɩ hɩrɛ to y.»
K'a meer bɩ ba ncɩnaaʊ bɩ, a a hʊr, an aa a danzaa Maarii bɩ bir, an a hɩ m sɩnsɛɛrɛ m, a ʊ: «Karɩnsaamba bʊr, an n'ɩbɩɩ birm.»
Leer n a hɩ m, a ʊ: «Pɩyɛɛr, aya, ŋ zɩnzɛ, ɩ ŋ bɩ!» Pɩyɛɛr n a nyɩ bɔ ʊ, a ʊ:
Dɔ k'a mɛ bɩ, wɔɔ lee ku Sidɔn ʊ, bɩ kʊ jɩnlɛ poore m bɩ, Zuliyus a ba Pol m mɩŋŋa. A zaa ka ʊ, k'an aa dɩga a gʊaasɩbarɔ ma, brɔɔ n nyasʊ m.

«K'a ta a yaa jɩm Wosocɛ ʊ b'ʊ, a mɩsɩrbaa daa naa do minno nɔɔn duro haay hɩ zamaa bɩ m.»
Bala, ŋ n wɔ ʊ ŋnɩ lɛ kʊ leer b'a cɩnta naa do si y. Leer b'a hɩ, a ʊ:

Yeezuu n a bɔ, an a hɩ wosocɛmannɩbənno jɩtannɔ wɔɔ m, kan Wosocɛ dɔmazannɔ cinno kɩ, kan gʊɔɔgusinno kʊ ŋ bʊr k'a b'a nyasʊ rɔ wɔɔ kɩ m, a ʊ: «Awɔɔ bʊr kan kargʊrɔ kɩ, bannɔ kɩ, ɩ ʊ, ta awɔɔ nawʊm koor nyasʊ jɩ ʊ.
«Wɔɔ zɩrɔ kʊ ŋ nyɩnta poohɔɔn ʊ rɔ wɔɔ, ŋ nyɩnta Woso taʊrɛ kasɛtɩ cɛ m. Ba a ʊ, amba Woso meer ba kan Moyiisi kɩ an a hɩ m bɩ m. A ʊ: ‹A ba amba hɔ niŋŋə k'ɩbɩɩ yɩ bɩ m.›
Karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ n a hɩ, ŋ ʊ: «Karɩnsaamba, zɩɩfʊrɔ a ka ma dɩɩtaa k'a ɩbɩɩ gʊngʊɛɛn jaarɔ m, ɩbɩɩ lɛ taa k'ɩ ɩ ya, ɩ ɩ bɔ, ɩ ta b'ʊ ra?»
Yeezuu Krista k'a nyɩnta lʊnlɔ jim bɩ, a maam her sɔ a gɔɔtam maam dɔmɩm haay.
Kʊ n hɔ da gʊaa wɔ ʊ k'a n dɩga a mim ma, hɔ kʊ n'a kam ma k'a zaa bɩ n a ba kɛɛrɛ bɩ, sɩrabarɛ m.
Zaan n a hɩ ŋ haay m, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ naa, batɛm mɔɔ n'a karɛ awɔɔ ʊ hi ʊ. Bɩ, gʊaa ɩ zɛm, a paŋŋa n lɛ da mɔɔ ra, bɩ mɔɔ n m ga m, m a kʊsɔrɔ bar tɔkkɛ hʊr y. A batɛm karɛ awɔɔ ʊ Sɛnt-Ɛspri m kan sɛ kɩ m.
Bɩ kʊ mɔɔ y'a barɛ, baa k'awɔɔ n sɩra ka mɔɔ ʊ, k'a sɩra ka a zibəə bɩ minto, k'a bɔkarɛ a dɔ mɩŋŋa, a ʊ, Zɩ ɩ kan mɔɔ kɩ, mɔɔ nɩ kan Zɩ kɩ.»
Zɩɩfʊrɔ m wɔɔ m, wɔɔ zɩrɔ ɩ nyɩnta maam, do vantɔɔ gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ Woso lɛrɔ dɔ rɔ bɛɛ n wɔɔ nɩ y.
K'a dɩga a, awɔɔ n a dɔ kɛɛrɛ a ʊ, gʊaa gʊta m na? Abraham yɛ an hɔ k'a yɩ haay yar bɩ k'a a da ma bɩ nɔ ʊ bɔ ʊ bu biyəə nɔ ʊ, deem an a ka ʊ.
Kʊ Filipi nɩ, a yɩ n yaa ʊ Azɔttɩ kʊ ʊ, an nɩ lemim nyɩnta bɩ pa dam kʊrɔ haay ʊ an nɩ cenim, an nɩ tam Sezaree kʊ ʊ.
A danyɩnɔ wɔɔ n a hɩ m, ŋ ʊ: «Ta Zidee ʊ, k'ɩ karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ n'ɩ zibəəro k'ɩbɩɩ nɩ ŋ bam nɔ wɔɔ yɩ sɔ.
Mimbirenyɩntazaa n'ɩbɩɩ m, ɩbɩɩ sɩra ka, ɩ ʊ, meerbaa kʊ n y'a hɩ ɩbɩɩ m Zuuba Woso tɔ ma bɩ kʊ yɩm.»
Bɩ, Woso a hɩ m, a ʊ: ‹Hɔɔnwarzaa ra, ɩbɩɩ gam gum naa ʊ. Hɔ k'ɩbɩɩ banka haay bɩ, nka n n'a sarɛ?›
Bɩ kʊ Woso barka n bɩr kan awɔɔ haay kɩ.
Amba danwur nɩ hɔyaa duum bɩ, wɔɔ lemim nyɩnta duu awɔɔ m. Amba gʊaa k'a nɩ hɔyaa zɔm bɩ, an n'a hɔjirle yɩm bɩ, a hɩ awɔɔ ʊ kʊ wɔɔ ɩ durnya hɔnyɩ yɩrɛ awɔɔ zi, a bʊnyaa ra?
K'a nyɩnta an nɩ hɔ bɩm kan ŋ kɩ bɩ, a bur sa an a barka da ʊ an bɔkarɛ an a zɩnzɛ ra, an a ka ŋ ʊ.
A ɩ gan wʊ gʊɔɔ ma. A a ka gɔsɩnnɔ n a ba a zibəəzannɔ, an a ka gɔsɩnnɔ m wosolɛsinnɩsorazannɔ. A n a ka nɔɔ m lemim nyɩnta padənno, an nɔɔrɔ ba a gʊɔɔ dundonno, hɔdɩndagʊɔɔnzannɔ m sɔ.
A n a hɩ m, a ʊ: ‹Ɩ gʊ ɩ kʊ bɩ ma, kan ɩ harzannɔ kɩ, ɩ ta tara kʊ mɔɔ n n'a hɩnkarɛ ɩbɩɩ m b'ʊ.›
Wosocikarɩnsaamba bɩ n a nyɩ bɔ ʊ, a ʊ: «Bɔ ɩ mɩŋŋabaa ba kan kɩ bɩ m.» Yeezuu n a hɩ m, a ʊ: «B'ɩbɩɩ sɔ, ta, ɩ ba maam sɔ.»
Hɔntazannɔ wɔɔ, k'a tʊr ka mɔɔ ma, k'a nyi ka a baa da, bala, awɔɔ fɩr yɩm gʊta.
Bɩ, k'a jɩ dɩnda ŋ nɩ bʊgʊ-bʊgʊdabaa m, kan daʊrɛ kɩ m, a bɩr noom hu m. Maam bɩ, gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ n'awɔɔ tɔ zarm, ŋn'a bʊnyaa hɩrɛ awɔɔ tarɛ ma Krista Zuure tɔ ma rɔ wɔɔ nyannɩ bɩrɛ.
Bala, naa ma kɛɛrɛ naa, kʊ gʊaa soor ɩ har deem ʊ, ŋ y'a gʊngʊm kʊ ma, gʊaa kaakʊ y'a gʊm gʊaa hɩɩya ma, gʊaa hɩɩya n a gʊ gʊaa kaakʊ ma.
Yimene kan Alɛsandɩr k'ɩ gʊɔɔ wɔɔ duro barla, mɔɔ wɔ daa ŋ ma Sʊtaana wɔ ʊ, kʊ ŋ nɩ hɔɔn ka, kʊ ŋ b'a ya ŋnɩ Woso sʊnsɔ wʊ y.
Sipiro ɩ nyɩnta b'ʊ sɔrdɩ, ŋnɩ tɩr hi tʊntɔŋ ʊ, zɩɩfʊrɔ wɔɔ *hubɔrɛ minto, amba ŋ tɩr a ba a Woso zaa zuure nɔ ʊ bɩ m. Bɩ sipi deem a da ma, an gər si si.
Hɔ kʊ mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ awɔɔ m ci b'ʊ naa, Woso n mɔɔ kasɛtɩzaa, ŋʊaar bɛɛ mɔɔ n'a barɛ y.
Mɔɔ yɩ m lɛ kʊsɩm gallɛm hɩɩya dɔmɩm saanhɩna nɔ ʊ, mɔɔ hɔnyɩ haay nɔ ʊ mɔɔ y'a bu hɔ karɛ ɩbɩɩ ʊ.
Tɩrgabaa bɩncɛ ʊ, ta mɔɔ nawʊrɛ m Zɩ zi, b'awɔɔ b'a yarɛ a mɔɔ yɩ y.
Bɩ minto bɩ, dʊdɔkarɛ hinni ʊ, Tiir kan Sidɔn kɩ hʊnhʊrlɛ bɩ nyɩntam gʊta, an awɔɔ hɔ bɩ ku y.

Mɔɔ kan danyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ naa ʊ haay rɔ wɔɔ kɩ, wɔɔ ɩ yaa darɛ awɔɔ m, awɔɔ kʊ kristagʊɔɔ sokʊmarɔ n'awɔɔ m, an nɩ Galasii kʊrɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ.
Kʊ gʊaa ba ʊ an nɩ lemim y'a hʊnhɔ bɩ wusigəm sokʊma bɩ nɔ ʊ, kʊ lemim y'a hʊnhɔ hɩrɛ zannɔ wɔɔ n ze pi, ŋnɩ bɩr a hɩrɛ a heer ʊ, ŋnɩ bɩr meer bam kan Woso kɩ.
Lʊ n nɩ tara nɔ ʊ b'ʊ, mimbʊnyaabər m. A n a ma ŋ ʊ, Yeezuu ɩ hɔ bɩm farizɛn har ʊ b'ʊ. A n bʊr gedre m, n n'a ba albatɩr jaa m, tidəər n a han,
Pɩyɛɛr k'a nɩ bɩrm lɛɛ haay ʊ bɩ, a ta wosogʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ Lida ʊ rɔ wɔɔ zi.
Dɔmɩm kʊ Woso a cɩnta bɩ k'a b'a ku an naa ba bɩ, a yɩ kasɛtɩ, an a hɩnkarɛ a ʊ, Woso lɛ taa k'a gʊaa haay bʊmbɔ.
Bɩ, amba Woso k'awɔɔ bir bɩ n mɩŋŋa bɩ, awɔɔ sɔ k'a bɩr mɩsɩrbaa mɩŋŋa bam a tarɛ haay nɔ ʊ.
Bɩ, Woso n gʊaa yar da lʊ tɔ ma y, lʊ a a da gʊaa yar tɔ ma.
Bala, hɔ kʊ leegure nɩ zɛm nɩ bɩ, bamɩŋŋa m, kan tɩrgabaa zibəə kɩ, kan sɩra kɩ.
Sɛnt-Ɛspri k'a a ka Etɩyɛnnɩ nɩ meer bam kan mindɔrɛ kɩ bɩ, ŋ bɩr a dam ma ŋn'a meerbaa bɩ nyɩ bɔŋ ʊ y.
Kɔɔlʊʊ bɩ zibəəzannɔ hɔ ba ɩ ʊ, a hɩ ŋ y'a ʊ k'a baŋŋarɔ gɔsɩnnɔ zo hi bɩ nɔ ʊ, k'an kɔɔlʊʊ bɩ nyasʊ, ŋn'a nyaakʊm da k'a bra si kan kɔɔlʊʊ poore bɩ kɩ.
Bɩ Woso a hɩ sɔ, a ʊ, a m mannɩbər jɩtaarɛ amba Mɛlkisedɛkkɩ m.
Pɩyɛɛr gɔɔta an maasɩrɛ ba Zoppee ʊ, zappa kʊ n n'a birm Sɩmɔɔn bɩ har ʊ.
Bɩ, gʊaa k'a gasʊ bakʊ bɩ lɛ m bɩ, bɩ zaa m seero wɔɔ dundor.
Mɔɔ m lɛɛgure, m bʊr durnya ʊ, kʊ gʊaa k'a nɩ sɩra kam mɔɔ ʊ bɩ bɩ gɔɔta monsigə ʊ y.
Naa ma kɛɛrɛ bɩ, do haay y'a hɩm mɔɔ ma mimbirenyɩntazaa.
Yeezuu n a nyɩ bɔ ŋ nʊ, a ʊ: «Dɩɩtaa awɔɔ bɔkarɛ an n'a hɩrɛ a ʊ, awɔɔ sɩra ka kɛɛrɛ ra?
Bɩ, Sol k'a hɔbɩrɛ bɩ bɩ, a a ya, an paŋŋa yɩ.
Gʊaa deem n wuti dʊdɔkənno wɔɔ bire ʊ. Farizɛn m, a tɔ m Gamalɩyɛl, wosocikarɩnsaamba m, gʊɔɔ wɔɔ n'a daŋ ʊ. A n lɛ ka kʊ ŋ nɩ bɔ kristazibəəzannɔ wɔɔ m cɩna,
Ziro kʊ Woso ŋ ba awɔɔ mɩsɩrbaa nɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ, bɔ ŋ y'a ʊ vam kan awɔɔ kɩ ra? Mɔɔ y'a gɩngam mɔɔ ʊ, ŋ bɩ vam kan awɔɔ kɩ sɩɩn!
A n a sa dɩɩtaa ma, k'a dɔmɩm k'a gɔɔta awɔɔ m k'a mɩsɩrbaa ba tara burə ʊ bɩ sa, a Woso hɔɔnhɔ ba m, a b'a sa a lɛtaamarɔ bʊnyaarɔ kʊ gʊɔɔ nɩ ŋ ŋʊam bɩ ba nɩ y.
Sɩra paan… mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ awɔɔ m, wakatɩ ɩ zɛm, b'a lee ku kɛɛrɛ. Gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ gɩnga rɔ wɔɔ Woso Nyɩ bɩ leer mam, bɩ gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ y'a ma rɔ wɔɔ y'a mɩm bɔŋ ʊ.
«Kʊ durnya sɔ awɔɔ m, k'a dɔ a ʊ, lɛɛ a ka an sɔ mɔɔ m.
Wɔɔ dɔ wɔɔ ʊ, Woso gʊɔɔ m wɔɔ m, bɩ durnya haay jilli ɩ *Bʊnyaabarɛzaa wɔ ʊ.
Naa tɔ ma bɩ, k'a mɩŋŋɔɔ zer a yɛ Woso ma. K'a a gu Sʊtaana ma, a y'a sire an a gʊ awɔɔ ma laatʊ.
Woso heerbusu dɔmɩm m dɔmɩnnɔ wɔɔ duro m, bɩ hɔ haay kʊ n y'a gʊrsɩra ba Wosoci ʊ bɩ n nɩ kʊ yɩŋ ʊ.
Gʊɔɔ cir gʊta, yaarɔ kan lannɔ kɩ ɩ sɩra kam Zuuba ʊ, ŋn'a zarlɛ ŋ la.
Yɩ a ʊ ncɩnaaʊ, gʊaa deem taan… naa tɔ ma, baa k'a gusi an a zɔ zɛ ma bɩ, yaŋŋɔɔ n nyɩnta ʊ gʊta, am monyaarɔ hɔ bɩ m, am nyɩntaayaa k'a nɩ higʊta lɛ ra bɩ m.
Gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ lɛɛ ka mɔɔ lɛɛ ŋnɩ bʊr lɔ wɔɔ, konno m, hɔyɔrɛzannɔ m sɔ. Bɩ, seero wɔɔ n a tʊr ka ŋ ma y.

Bɩ dɔ k'a mɛ bɩ, Pol gʊɔɔ wɔɔ gaa, an dintim gʊ a ma sɩŋŋɩda sa hɔdeem kan ŋ kɩ. A n ta Wosocɛ ʊ, k'a dintim gʊ a ma bɩ nyarɛ dɔmɩm cɩnta, k'an yɩ hindeem ʊ kan gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ yaa ler bɔ Woso m nɔ wɔɔ ganwʊrɛ karɛ kɩ.
Kʊ wɔɔ to an n'a barɛ ncɩnaaʊ gʊaa haay sɩra kaŋ ʊ, *Rɔm zannɔ zɛm, ŋnɩ bɩ wɔɔ *Wosocɛ bɩ da, kan wɔɔ do bɩ kɩ.»
Denter m, mɔɔ dɔ mɔɔ ʊ, Woso a busu an ta m arzana ʊ, a a da ma hɔhɩnkarɛ a a yɩ, a a da ma Woso a busu paan… an ta m arzana ʊ b'ʊ, Woso ɩ naa dɔ mɔɔ n a dɔ y.

Woso a mɩm bɔ ʊ a dɔmɩm kaakʊ hɔ ma, an lɛ ka ʊ k'an a taʊrɛ hɩnka.
Bɩ Yeezuu a hɩ ŋ nɩ, a ʊ: «K'a to maam.» A n bɔkarɛ an a wɔ da gʊaa bɩ tʊr bɩ ma, an a waa.
Ŋ n a hɩ, ŋ ʊ: «Nka n'ɩbɩɩ nɩ?» Yeezuu n a nyɩ bɔ ŋ nʊ, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ n'a mim hɩrɛ awɔɔ m tee… bɩ m.
Yeezuu n a ya, an a hɩ, a ʊ: «Laafɩɩ n bɩr kan awɔɔ kɩ. Kʊ mɔɔ Zɩ mɔɔ nyɔɔ bɩ, mɔɔ y'awɔɔ nyɔɔm sɔ.»
Ezayii deem-deem b'a hɩ kʊ bɔ minto y'a ka, ŋ b'a dam ma, ŋn'a si y:
K'a bɩr a bam kʊ m mɩŋŋa, a bɩr a dam kʊ han, a bɩ naa barɛ tɔ bɔ a nɔ ʊ y. Bala, bɔ a ʊ kʊ ʊ, ɩ ʊ, mannɩrɔ m, Woso yɩ ŋ ŋʊam.
Wakatɩ kʊ Zɩ Woso daʊrɛ kan lɛbɔʊrɛ kɩ ka ʊ bɩ, wɔɔ nyɩnta b'ʊ. Woso mɩŋŋa nyɩnta a lɛbɔʊrɛ gʊta nɔ ʊ, an meer ba kan kɩ, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ Nyɩ m naa do, mɔɔ n'a ŋʊam gʊta.»
A danyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ Listɩr ʊ kan Ikonɩyɔm kɩ rɔ wɔɔ y'a lɛ bɔrɛ a tɔ ʊ.
k'an nyɩnta lemim nyɩnta zibəəzaa, bɩncɛ kʊ Zidas a to an ta a bɩncɛ ʊ bɩ.»
K'a har n gɔɔta zer, kʊ gɔsɩ bɩ nyɩnta ʊ y.
M danyɩnɔ, kʊ gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ gɩnga rɔ wɔɔ mim bɩncɛ nɩ, wɔɔ lɛ baa k'awɔɔ n gɔɔta badɔ nɔ ʊ, a bɩr heerzarlɛ m amba gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ ba taaheerlɛ m nɔ wɔɔ nɩ y.

Pɩlatɩ n a bɔ, an bɔ garga ra, an a hɩ zɩɩfʊrɔ wɔɔ m, a ʊ: «Awɔɔ yɩ ra, mɔɔ y'a gaarɛ, m bɔ m garga ra naa ʊ. Awɔɔ y'a dɔrɛ a ʊ, mɔɔ n mim k'a a zar bɩ yɩ y.»
A n a hɩ m, a ʊ: Dɩga a, a dɔɔraa gʊta mɔɔ n'ɩbɩɩ zi bam, mɔɔ n kaanm ɩbɩɩ lɛ m deem nɩ y. B'ɩbɩɩ n binnyɛɛm ka mɔɔ ʊ cɩna m a zɛ, m cibsa ba m kan m hannyɩnɔ kɩ y.
K'a hi k'a lʊr dɩvɛn bɩ da a lɛ ma bɩ, a n a dɔ k'a to a ʊ ka y. Bɩ, zibəənyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ y'a kusi rɔ wɔɔ a dɔ. A lʊ bɩ zim bɩ bir,
Bala, Ɛspri kʊ Woso a ka wɔɔ ʊ bɩ bɩr wɔɔ dam nyibəə ma y, bɩ, paŋŋa kan ŋʊarɛ kɩ, daamɩŋŋama kɩ an n'a kam wɔɔ ʊ.
K'awɔɔ n hɔ k'a gʊrsɩra ba bɩ si, awɔɔ y'a bam lɔ k'a hɔ kʊ mɔɔ n'a hɩm bɩ si?»
Sɩra m, wɔɔ heer kookoo, kʊ wɔɔ ʊ bɔ ʊ mɛ naa do ʊ, ʊ ta ʊ nɩ kan Zuuba kɩ, a jɩra wɔɔ m.
Bɩ, k'awɔɔ nɩ, Krista y'a so awɔɔ ʊ, Woso n a so Krista ʊ.
Nkɔɔ Woso nɔ ma ʊ kan ŋ kɩ dɔɔraa bam busi bɩ? Gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ mimbʊnyaa ba, ŋnɩ gɩnga poo ʊ b'ʊ rɔ wɔɔ m.
Gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nyɩnta ŋn'ɩ hɔbɩrɛ bɩm kan kɩ rɔ wɔɔ y'a hɩrɛ a heer ʊ, ŋ ʊ: «Nka m gʊaa naa do nɩ? A n yɛ an nɩ mimbʊnyaarɔ sugur karɛ?»
Ŋ nɩ zɛ pi. Kɛɛrɛ bɩ, Yeezuu n yaabazaa bɩ gaa, an a waa, an a da zaa ra.
Jaa kʊ cɛdonno wɔɔ kaanm m bɩ y'a ba cɛ bɩ jɩrjaa paŋŋazaa.
Pɩlatɩ n a hɩ wosocɛmannɩbənno jɩtannɔ wɔɔ m kan zamaa bɩ kɩ, a ʊ: «Mɔɔ n gʊaa naa do kʊrɔma yɩ y.»
Mɔɔ bɩ m dam ma, m hɔsɩ ba, m mɩŋŋa paŋŋa nɩ y. Hɔ kʊ mɔɔ n'a mam bɩ mɔɔ n'a dʊdɔ kam, bɩ mɔɔ dʊdɔkarɛ bɩ tɩrga, bala, mɔɔ bɩr m karɛ m mɩŋŋa hɔɔnhɔ ma y. Zɩ k'a mɔɔ nyɔɔ bɩ hɔɔnhɔ mɔɔ n nɩ m kam ma.
Ncɩnaaʊ nɩ, n nɩ lɛ k'a nyɩnta ʊ biisi bɩ ci zɛ, bala, a paŋŋa ba ʊ, b'a b'a dam ma an a da gʊaa han y.
ŋn'a zɔ ma, ŋn'a hɩrɛ, ŋ ʊ: «Wɔɔ ɩ yaa darɛ ɩbɩɩ m, zɩɩfʊrɔ cir!» Ŋ n'a wɔ tɩntam lɛ.
Ŋ n bʊr Zaan zi, ŋnɩ b'a hɩ, ŋ ʊ: «Karɩnsaamba, gʊaa k'a nyɩnta kan ɩbɩɩ kɩ Zʊrdɛn kɔ zeezi bɩ, ɩbɩɩ n a kasɛtɩ ka bɩ, a ɩ batɛm kam kɛɛrɛ sɔ, gʊaa haay nɩ tam zi.»
Bɩ her naa, kʊ mɔɔ Woso lerbɔrɛ k'a ba wɔɔ zɩrɔ m bɩ si bɩ, bɩ y'a ba mɔɔ dʊdɔ her.
Ta mɔɔ nawʊm Masedʊan kʊ ʊ, m a dɔ m lee ku awɔɔ zi, bra mɔɔ nawʊm b'ʊ, m bʊr awɔɔ zi.
Wɔɔ lɛ n taa k'ɩbɩɩ n hɔ k'ɩbɩɩ n'ɩ hɔɔn dam ma bɩ hɩ k'ʊ a ma, bala, lɛɛ haay ʊ, wɔɔ dɔ mɩŋŋa ŋ bɩr yɛm gʊngʊrɛ k'ɩbɩɩ nɩ zuŋ ʊ naa ʊ y.»
Bala, n y'a gʊrsɩra ba, n ʊ: Woso lɛ karɛ a malɛɛkarɔ ʊ, kʊ ŋ nɩ dɔ ɩbɩɩ ma,
Zamaa k'a bʊr an nɩ cenim an a ma bɩ, a laaka da kʊ bɔ m gɛ.
Bɩ, kʊ Yeezuu nɩ, ta a tɩr a ʊ a deem bɔlɛɛmarɔ ʊ, an bɩr yaa darɛ.
K'awɔɔ mɔɔ ci bɩ karɩnda ba, k'a ka Lawodisee kristagʊɔɔ sokʊma b'ʊ, kʊ ŋ n'a karɩnda ba sɔ. K'awɔɔ n ci k'a n'a tom Lawodisee ʊ bɩ karɩnda ba sɔ.
Yeezuu n Natanayɛl yɩ, an nɩ zɛm zi, an a mim dɩnda, a ʊ: «Ba Israyɛl gʊaa paan… n na, a zambʊ ba ʊ y.»
Bɩ, kɛɛrɛ naa, Woso awɔɔ mɩm bɔ ʊ kan Krista kɩ,
B'awɔɔ, m danyɩnɔ, amba Izakkɩ m bɩ, ler kʊ Woso a bɔ bɩ nyɩnɔ n'awɔɔ m.
Hɔ kʊ mɔɔ hɩ naa, lɛ bɛɛ mɔɔ n'a karɛ awɔɔ ʊ y, a ɩ yɩrɛ ɩ ʊ, awɔɔ a da ma, a naa ba.
Yeezuu k'a ŋ sɩrakarɛ bɩ yɩ bɩ, a a hɩ yaabazaa bɩ m, a ʊ: «Gʊaa, ɩ ɩ mimbʊnyaarɔ sugur yɩ.»
Mɔɔ lɛɛ kam m ɩbɩɩ bʊmbɔ ɩ do kan do vantɔɔ kʊ mɔɔ n n'ɩbɩɩ nyɔɔrɛ ŋ ma rɔ wɔɔ kɩ wɔ ʊ,
A n bra si, an aa Sɩmɔɔn Pɩyɛɛr yɩ, kan karɩndanyɩ deem kʊ Yeezuu a ŋʊa bɩ kɩ, an a hɩ ŋ nɩ, a ʊ: «N Zuuba bɔ yaa b'ʊ, bɩ wɔɔ n a dɔ kʊ ta n y'a ʊ m ka y.»
Bala, awɔɔ gɔɔta an nɩ durnya mɩsɩrbaa bam. Jɩmbaa kan nyaa kɩ y'awɔɔ bire ʊ, naa bɩr a hɩnkarɛ a ʊ, awɔɔ gɔɔta an nɩ durnya mɩsɩrbaa bam, an nɩ tam am gʊaa k'an Woso dɔ m naa?
Gʊɔɔ gɔsɩnnɔ sɩrakarɛ to ŋn'a nyʊnnyɔɔ, kʊ ŋ ʊ, a ta hɔdɔrɛ naa do m bɩ tɔ ma.
Nyɩnta kʊ wɔɔ ʊ kan kɩ ci mɩŋŋa bɩ burə ʊ bɩ, wɔɔ leer naa do k'a a to brama bɩ ma ʊ zim.
M gʊaasɩbɔɔ, lɛ daa bɛɛ mɔɔ n'a gʊrsɩra barɛ awɔɔ ma y, lɛ gusire m, awɔɔ n ta m a sɩŋŋɩda ʊ. Lɛ gusire naa do, meerbaa k'awɔɔ ma bɩ m.
Naa tɔ ma bɩ, k'a hɔ k'an bʊnyaa a heer ʊ haay to, a a gʊ mimbʊnyaa haay ma.
Zoppee zannɔ haay a ma, gʊɔɔ gʊta n sɩra ka Zuuba ʊ.
B'ɩbɩɩ nyɩ k'a ɩbɩɩ arzaka gʊr, an aa a zar kan lannɔmɩŋŋaheenno kɩ an a bɔ an bʊr naa, ɩbɩɩ dinnyɛɛm k'a mɛ ka bɩ zɛ a minto.
Mɔɔ bɩr meer bɩ barɛ awɔɔ haay minto y. Mɔɔ gʊɔɔ kʊ mɔɔ ŋ bɔ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ dɔ. Kʊ *Wosoci bɩ meerbaa naa do n kʊ yɩ: ‹Gʊaa k'a nɩ hɔ bɩm kan mɔɔ kɩ b'a ba mɔɔ jɩm.›
K'awɔɔ b'a so kʊ ma k'a mim naa do dɩnda, mɔɔ heer nyɩntam kan awɔɔ kɩ, wakatɩ bɩ do ʊ bɩ, k'a gʊaa bɩ do dʊdɔ yar Zuuba Yeezuu tɔ kan a paŋŋa kɩ m.
Zɩɩfʊrɔ wɔɔ, a ka brɔɔ n nawʊm hoserlo ma, grɛkkɩrɔ wɔɔ n'a kam mindɔrɛ ma,
k'a yɛ gʊɔɔ ncɩnaaʊ rɔ wɔɔ ma, kan gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ zi bam, ŋn'ɩ kɔrɛ yɩm kan ŋ kɩ rɔ wɔɔ ma sɔ.
Dɔmɩm bɩ do tɛkka ma bɩ, *karɩndanyɩnɔ gʊta a bɔ a jɛ ʊ, ŋ n a ya, ŋn'ɩ zum kʊ ʊ kan kɩ y.
Naa y'a hɩnkarɛ a ʊ, Davɩd y'a birm ‹Zuuba›. A nyɩnnɩ m lʊnlɔ kɛɛrɛ?»
M danyɩnɔ ŋʊarɛrɔ, k'a tɔ da a nɔ ʊ, a ʊ, gʊaa biyəə a ga m an bɩr a tʊr kam mɩŋŋa, b'a bɩ nyagɩra ba k'a meer ba, a bɩ nyagɩra ba sɔ k'a nɔmaa ba y.
Kʊ ŋ heer a zɛ kʊ ma kan minno nɔɔn duro marɛ kɩ bɩ, ŋ Pɩyɛɛr lar kan kristazibəəzannɔ gɔsɩnnɔ wɔɔ kɩ, ŋ ʊ: «Kʊ a ba lɔ, ʊ danyɩnɔ?»
Bɩ, k'a yɛ nyɩdazaambaa ma an a tʊntɔ ʊ sɩrakarɛ nɔ ʊ, kan ŋʊarɛ kɩ, mɩŋŋabaa kɩ, mɩŋŋazerle kɩ, a bʊmbɔrɛ yɩm.
Lɛɛzannɔ y'a so mɔɔ mɩŋŋa ʊ, mɔɔ nɩ m so sʊrdaarɔ ʊ. Kʊ mɔɔ hɩ deem m, an ta, a tam. Kʊ mɔɔ hɩ a vanta m, an bʊr, a zɛm. Kʊ mɔɔ hɩ zibəənyɩ m, an naa ba, a y'a bam.»
Naa tɔ ma bɩ, mɔɔ lɛ taa kʊ zonno pooro wɔɔ n'a ya ŋnɩ cɛ ka, ŋnɩ nyɩnɔ yɩ, ŋnɩ dɩga a jɛɛr mim ma mɩŋŋa, kʊ ŋ bɩ zaa ka wɔɔ jɩnnɔ wɔɔ ʊ, ŋn'a da ma, ŋn'a bʊnyaa hɩ wɔɔ ma y.
A n bɔkarɛ, an a hɩ ŋ nɩ, a ʊ: «Awɔɔ sɩrakarɛ b'ɩ ka?» Dabɔʊ nɩ ŋ nyasʊ, ŋ n zɛ kədə, ŋn'a hɩm kʊ m, ŋ ʊ: «Nka m gʊaa naa do nɩ? A n nɩ lɛ kam hɩnhɛr ʊ kan hi kɩ, ŋn'a lɛ sire!»
Hɩrɔɔdɩ ʊ: «Mɔɔ ka ŋnɩ Zaan mim gʊ ma. Bɩ, nka ŋn'a mim dɩndam mɔɔ n'a mam naa?» A n n'a kam ma k'a yɩ.
M danyɩnɔ, k'a dɔ a ʊ, lemim nyɩnta kʊ mɔɔ pa da awɔɔ m bɩ n a to gʊɔɔ zi y.
Yeezuu n nyɩ bɩ sa a wɔ ma, an a bir, a ʊ: «M nyɩnnɩ, wuti!»
K'a bɩr yɛm kʊ ma, bɩ kʊ gʊaa ɩ mim m kan a mim kɩ, k'a sugur ka kʊ ʊ. Amba Zuuba sugur ka awɔɔ ʊ bɩ, k'a ba maam sɔ.
Bʊr k'a ʊ, awɔɔ zi b'ʊ, awɔɔ n a si mɩŋŋa kan nyibəə kɩ daʊrɛ kɩ, a yɛ a lɛ ma bɩ, a y'a tɔ darɛ a nɔ ʊ, an n'awɔɔ ŋʊam gʊta an cem biisi han.
«Nyɩyar ɩ naa ʊ, an nɩ bur m soor, kan zɔnɔ kɩ hɩɩya. Bɩ, bɔ naa n n'a bam gʊaa cir naa nɩ?»
Sɩra mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ awɔɔ m: gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ naa ʊ rɔ wɔɔ barla, gɔsɩnnɔ Woso cirbəə bɩ yɩm, a mɩsɩrbaa dɔmɩm ʊ.»
A b'a zu a ʊ y, k'a dundo a zi. Sʊtaana awɔɔ jɩm b'ɩ kumkum lɛɛ ma am poozaa hɔ bɩ m, an nɩ baa dam, an n'a kam gʊaa ma k'a nyasʊ a bɩ.
Mɔɔ heernyɔɔ gʊta yɩ, kʊ mɔɔ ɩ nyɩnɔ gɔsɩnnɔ yɩ, ŋn'ɩ tam sɩra zaa ra, amba lɛ kʊ wɔɔ Zɩ Woso a ka wɔɔ ʊ bɩ m.
Kʊ Krista n'awɔɔ mɩsɩrbaa bɩ, k'a b'a hɩnka, a y'awɔɔ hɩnkam sɔ kan a kɩ, a nyɩnta a lɛbɔʊrɛ nɔ ʊ.
Hɔ kʊ n y'a da Wosoci bɩ nɔ ʊ haay bɩ, Woso Ɛspri y'a ka n n'a da ʊ, bɩ, ta an a wʊ ʊ gʊɔɔ hɔdɩndarɛ minto, k'a nyʊnnyɔɔrɛ da jɩm ʊ, k'a gʊaa bɔ zaa ʊ, k'a mɩsɩrbaa tɩrga barɛ dɩnda gʊaa m.
Hɔ kʊ mɔɔ ʊ kʊ m a yɛ awɔɔ han kɛɛrɛ bɩ, ba n nɩ: awɔɔ dɔ a ʊ, mɔɔ du n y'a ʊ kʊ mɔɔ nɩ Krista zi bam bɩ tɔ ma. K'a mɩsɩrbaa ba amba Woso mɩŋŋa lɛ n taa, an awɔɔ bir ma bɩ m.
Kʊ m a pa da kʊ n a jɩ ma paan…, amba mɔɔ m ga m, m a ba bɩ m.
K'awɔɔ yɩ ŋn'ɩ lɛɛ daa darɛ, awɔɔ dɔ mɩŋŋa a ʊ, siire a zɔ.
Kʊ ŋn'ɩ maasɩrɛ bam b'ʊ poore bɩ, Fɛstus Pol mim bɩ sa, an a dɩnda cir bɩ m, a ʊ: «Gʊaa n nɩ naa ʊ, Feligsi n a to lɔnnɔcɛ ʊ.
Yeezuu ɩ lam zinə k'a gʊaa ba bəətir bɩ la. Bɩ, zinə bɩ k'a bɔ bɩ, bəətir b'ɩ meer bam, zamaa bɩ n zɛ kədə.
Kʊ wɔɔ sɩra ka, ʊ ʊ Yeezuu ga an a mɩm bɔ ʊ bɩ, maam sɔ bɩ, gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ sɩra ka Yeezuu ʊ ŋnɩ bɔkarɛ ŋnɩ gɩnga rɔ wɔɔ, Woso brɔɔ mɩm bɔŋ ʊ ŋnɩ mɩsɩrbaa ba kan Yeezuu kɩ.
A n nɩ dɔrɛ a Nyɩ Yeezuu kʊ Woso mɩŋŋa a mɩm bɔ ʊ gəəno bire ʊ, an n'a tom brama k'a bʊr bɩ ma, an nɩ wɔɔ yɔm Woso nɔmaa k'a nɩ zɛm bɩ wɔ ʊ.
Dɔmɩnnɔ cem gʊta, kɔɔlʊʊ bɩ tarɛ nyibəə n ta ʊ, bɩ ma bɩ, lɛkʊsɩrɛ dɔmɩm cem. Pol n ŋ dʊndɔ, a ʊ:
Yeezuu n a hɩ ŋ nɩ, a ʊ: «Do vantɔɔ cinno ɩ cirbəə bɩm ŋn'a so a tarazannɔ ʊ, bɩ cinno wɔɔ y'a kam gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ y'a so ŋ ʊ rɔ wɔɔ nɩ ŋ birm: mimmɩŋŋabənno.
Bɩ kɛɛrɛ naa, mannɩbər zibəə k'a lɛ da brɔɔ hɔ bɩ ra gʊta bɩ Yeezuu n n'a bam. Bala, am gʊaasɩbabaa k'an mɩŋŋa an lɛ da bɩ zɛkʊrazaa, gʊaasɩbabaa bɩ do jɩr bɩ, lerbɔrɛrɔ mɩŋŋɔɔ kʊ ŋ lɛ da a yo ma.
Sabaa hinni vanta ʊ, Yeezuu gasʊ sokʊmacɛ ʊ, an nɩ hɔ dɩndam. Gʊaa nɩ b'ʊ, a bɩsɩ ra wɔ n ga.
Malɛɛka bɩ n a hɩ, a ʊ: «Gabrɩyɛl m mɔɔ m, m nɩ Woso lɛɛ. Mɔɔ nyɔɔ a ʊ, kʊ m bɩ meer ba kan ɩbɩɩ kɩ, kʊ m bɩ lemim nyɩnta hɩ ɩbɩɩ m.

Dɔmɩnnɔ wɔɔ duro ʊ bɩ, karɩndanyɩnɔ wɔɔ lɛ y'a dam la, zɩɩfʊrɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ grɛkkɩ lemim hɩm nɔ wɔɔ n wuti kukur barɛ m kan kʊ bɩ zɩɩfʊrɔ wɔɔ kɩ. Bala, ŋ dɔmɩm haay hɔ jirle bɩ, ŋ bɩr a karɛ ŋ zonno wɔɔ ʊ y.
Gɛɛ cir bɔ n ta ʊ, k'a ɩ tam k'a yaa yar ba kan cir vanta kɩ, a n lɛɛ ka an nyɩnta an dɩga, k'a y'a dam ma kan gʊaa tisi bu kɩ, a yar ba kan gʊaa k'a nɩ gʊaa m tisi buhɩra bɩ kɩ gɛ?
Meer naa do ba mɔɔ nawʊm kan awɔɔ haay kɩ kɛɛrɛ: K'a ka, k'a hɔɔn n bɩr deem, a bɩr kʊ cicir zɛm, a bɩr kʊ ŋʊam danyɩbaa nɔ ʊ, a bɩr a mɩŋŋa bam kʊ m, a bɩr mɩŋŋazerle m.
A n a sa Abɛl ma lore ma, an ta m Zakarii k'a ga Wosocɛ ʊ, mannɩjaa bɩ kan bɩncɛ mɩŋŋa bɩ kɩ bire ʊ. Sɩra mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ awɔɔ m, ŋ her naa ʊ gʊɔɔ nɔɔn duro hʊnhʊrm minno nɔɔn duro minto.
Hɔ kʊ mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ m nɩ m gumə dɩndam, gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ nɩ mim kam mɔɔ ra rɔ wɔɔ lɛɛ bɩ ba n nɩ:
A yɛ mɔɔ nawʊrɛ ɩbɩɩ han paan… Woso mɩm ʊ, kan Krista Yeezuu kɩ mɩm ʊ, bɩ zɛm bɩ gʊɔɔ mɩsɩɩrɔ kan gəəno kɩ dʊdɔ ka, a yɛ mɔɔ nawʊrɛ ɩbɩɩ han, hinni k'a nɩ zɛŋ ʊ k'a bɩ cirbəə bɩ bɩ tɔ ma sɔ,
Nyɩnta a ʊ: Magdalaa Maarii, kan Zannɩ kɩ, kan Zakkɩ da Maarii kɩ. Lannɔ gɔsɩnnɔ kʊ ŋ nyɩnta kan ŋ kɩ rɔ wɔɔ mim naa do hɩ kristazibəəzannɔ wɔɔ m sɔ.
Bɩ m Pol bir, Tɛrtulus n a sɩŋŋɩda sa, an nɩ mim karɛ a lɛ m, a ʊ: «Feligsi mɩŋŋa, ɩbɩɩ minto y'a ka wɔɔ n laafɩɩ yɩ gʊta, lʊnlʊrlɛrɔ k'ɩbɩɩ ŋ ba wɔɔ bire ʊ wɔɔ do naa minto, bɩ tɔ ma.

Mɔɔ n a nyɩ bɔ ʊ, mɔɔ ʊ: ‹Nka n'ɩbɩɩ nɩ, Zuuba?› Zuuba n a ya, an a hɩ, a ʊ: ‹Yeezuu m mɔɔ m, mɔɔ ɩbɩɩ n nɩ fɩr karɛ ŋ ma.
Bɩ jɛ ʊ bɩ, Yeezuu b'a yɩ *Wosocɛ ʊ, an a hɩ m, a ʊ: «Ba ɩbɩɩ laafɩɩ yɩ kɛɛrɛ na. Ɩ b'ɩ ya, ɩ mimbʊnyaa ba y, mim y'a ɩ yɩ, an lɛ da biisi hɔ naa ra.»

«Ayo Zuuba, mɔɔ mɩsɩrbaa nɔ ʊ, mɔɔ n hɔ bʊnyaa kan dintim hɔ kɩ bɩ cɩna y. Wɔɔ do sɩhɔ m.»
Gɛɛ, awɔɔ n a dɔ a ʊ, awɔɔ mɛ bɩ Sɛnt-Ɛspri cɛ m, Woso n a ka awɔɔ ʊ, an n'awɔɔ heer ʊ ra? Bɩ minto bɩ, awɔɔ bɛɛ y'a so a mɩŋŋɔɔ ʊ dɔ ra? Woso y'a so awɔɔ ʊ.
Amba *Moyiisi k'a mɩm busu brama poohɔɔn ʊ bɩ, pakra m kʊ n n Gʊaanyɩ bɩ busu sɔ.
Bɩ ma bɩ, zɩɩfʊrɔ cir gʊta a ma, ŋ ʊ, Yeezuu bʊr b'ʊ. Ŋ n bʊr zi, bɩ ŋ n bʊr a minto bala y, bʊr ŋ y'a ʊ k'a bɩ Lazaar k'a mɩm bɔ ʊ gəəno bire ʊ bɩ yɩ.
Gɔsɩ b'a gore bɔ ʊ y. K'a a da han k'an a bɔ an bʊr mɔɔ zi laafɩɩ, bala, mɔɔ y'a mɩm dam, kan danyɩnɔ wɔɔ kɩ.
K'awɔɔ ɩ hɔ mɩŋŋa bam gʊɔɔ kʊ ŋ n'a barɛ awɔɔ n nɔ wɔɔ nɩ, a nyɔɔdʊ ɩ ka? Mimbʊnyaabənno wɔɔ y'a bam maam sɔ.
ŋn'ɩ dɩgam gʊaa k'a waa bɩ ma a jɩr ʊ, ŋ n hɔ k'a n'a hɩm bɩ dɔ y.
K'a Pɩyɛɛr yɩ kan Zaan kɩ, ŋn'ɩ tam k'a gasʊ Wosocɛ ʊ b'ʊ bɩ, a hɔ yɛ ŋ han.
Bɔ ŋ y'a ʊ kʊ ʊ kan nyɩnɔ kʊ ŋ yaa nyɩnta daasɩ ʊ, ŋn'a to ŋn'ɩ kʊ bimbirm nɔ wɔɔ kɩ, ŋ ʊ: Wɔɔ hir hɛ awɔɔ m, b'awɔɔ n sar ba y! Wɔɔ zɛ laa lɔ b'awɔɔ n nyi ka y?

Ɩ bɩ həən si gʊaa gusire ma kan paŋŋa kɩ y, bɩ, dɩga ma ɩ zɩ, ɩ dʊndɔ. Nyukumbonno wɔɔ dʊndɔ danyɩbaa nɔ ʊ.
